segments.title: 第197章 叔叔阿姨好
segments.content:
Return of the Green Years Chapter 197 Hello, Uncle and Auntie

At Lin Xiuhong's request, Li Luo reluctantly took out the clothes and pants the three girls had given him and changed into them.

What Yan Zhusheng had bought for him was a high-necked, beige sweater. It was paired with the dark blue down jacket Ying Chanxi had bought for him, and the black wide-leg pants from Xu Youyu.

After swapping his school uniform for this new outfit, the already handsome Li Luo suddenly took on a trendier air, with an added touch of maturity compared to when he wore his uniform.

If Li Luo were to walk out dressed like this and get a more fashionable haircut, no one would likely recognize him as a high school student.

"It looks quite good." Lin Xiuhong nodded in satisfaction. "You look like a proper person now."

"What's that supposed to mean?" Li Luo was speechless. "Didn't I look like a person before?"

"Why are you interrupting me when I'm talking?" Lin Xiuhong shot him a glance, then asked, "Why did Xixi and the other two think of giving you clothes? And all at once."

"What's the big deal?" Li Luo asked back, puzzled. "Isn't it normal for Xixi to give me a piece of clothing? Yan Zhusheng is my deskmate, and I usually take care of her in class. As for my senpai, she lives with us after all, and I even make her late-night snacks. It's normal for her to give me a pair of pants."

"Is that so?" Lin Xiuhong looked at her son, then at her husband.

Li Guohong hesitated for a moment, then nodded and said, "I suppose so. It's quite normal for good classmates to exchange gifts."

This was quite a stretch for Li Guohong.

After all, his high school days were in the last century. How would he know what young people these days were thinking?

"But," Li Guohong added, "since they gave you gifts, you should at least give something back in return. Otherwise, it wouldn't be right."

"Hey, speaking of which." Hearing him say that, Lin Xiuhong suddenly remembered something. She quickly stood up, walked into the bedroom, and came out with several scarves. She said to Li Luo, "I've knitted a few scarves recently. Take a few."

Li Luo blinked, looking down at the scarves in his mother's hands, not feeling particularly surprised.

After all, in the months before the New Year, Lin Xiuhong would often do some needlework in her free time after a long day's work. It had become a habit.

So he thought for a moment and took a white one, an orange one, and a red one.

Seeing that Li Luo only took three, Lin Xiuhong frowned. "Take one more. Replace the one on your neck. I don't know where you bought it."

"Um..." Li Luo coughed twice and explained in a low voice, "Xixi knitted this scarf. It's better not to change it."

Otherwise, he'd probably be beaten to death.

But this time, both Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong were even more stunned.

They didn't react for a long time.

"Xixi knitted it?" Lin Xiuhong repeatedly confirmed.

"Yeah."

"Fine." Lin Xiuhong put the remaining scarves away. "I'll accept the clothes you bought. I'll take the ones you bought for grandpa and grandma to them in a couple of days to make them happy too."

After settling the matter of the clothes, Li Luo watched as Lin Xiuhong packed them up and suddenly remembered something. He said to his parents, "There's one more thing I need to tell you."

"What is it?" Li Guohong had just taken out a cigarette, about to go to the balcony to relax, but was stopped again by Li Luo. He couldn't help but ask.

"It's about, well, my royalties for last month have been calculated. They'll be deposited into my bank card on the 12th," Li Luo said.

"Oh, I know." Lin Xiuhong nodded. "What's wrong?"

Because Li Luo was a minor and couldn't apply for a bank card himself, Lin Xiuhong had gotten one for him. Although Li Luo's personal information was filled in, two phone numbers could be registered.

One was the minor's own number, and the other was a parent's number.

So, if Lin Xiuhong wanted to, she could also check the bank card's information, like the balance, via text message.

However, out of trust for her son, Lin Xiuhong usually never actively checked.

After all, Li Luo was usually at school, and when he stayed at Bibo Lanting, Ying Chanxi was there to keep an eye on him. She wasn't worried that he would suddenly spend money recklessly on some nonsense.

Furthermore, Li Luo's academic performance was now excellent. In Lin Xiuhong's eyes, he was at a level where he should be praised for doing good deeds, and if he did something wrong, she should first consider whether it might actually be a good thing.

So, she no longer looked at her son with the suspicious gaze of someone watching a thief like before.

But in the next second, what Li Luo said still sent a shock through both of his parents.

"Last month's royalties were forty-five thousand. After tax, it should be a little over forty thousand."

"What?" Lin Xiuhong was completely stunned, feeling like she'd been jumping in surprise all day. How long had it been since she last asked about Li Luo's writing situation? How did his royalties suddenly surge again?

Was writing this profitable these days?

It was like picking up money off the street.

Li Guohong also stood frozen in place, the cigarette between his fingers nearly dropping to the floor.

"Are you sure? Over forty thousand?" Li Guohong's voice was a little hoarse, his face filled with disbelief.

The two of them worked hard every day, waking up early and going to bed late at the breakfast shop, and they still didn't earn as much as Li Luo did from his casual writing.

How could this be fair?

"Let me check." Lin Xiuhong took out her phone with a trembling hand, wanting to check the bank card information via text.

But Li Luo quickly reminded her, "Didn't I say? The royalties are only paid on the 12th. We still have to wait two days."

"Let me at least see how much is in there now." As Lin Xiuhong spoke, she had already sent the text message and soon received a reply from the bank.

But when she saw the bank card balance displayed in the message, which was a whopping five hundred thousand plus, she was completely dumbfounded, unable to process it for a moment.

"...Li, Li Luo!" Lin Xiuhong's voice became a bit shrill as she questioned Li Luo in a slight panic, "You, you... didn't you say it was only forty thousand? And it shouldn't have been deposited yet, right? What's with this five hundred thousand plus in your card?!"

"What the heck?" Li Guohong was stunned again, feeling like his brain was running out of capacity. He quickly leaned over to his wife's side for a look, then sucked in a breath of cold air. "It really is five hundred thousand!"

Hearing his parents say that, Li Luo himself was also a bit stunned.

In his memory, his total royalties, after deducting the mortgage payments for the past few months, should be around a hundred thousand.

Besides that, there should be the copyright fees from selling the two songs, "The Chaser of Light" and "Light"—one for 120,000, the other for 90,000. Adding it all up, the total should be just over three hundred thousand.

He had originally wanted to show off a little in front of his parents and incidentally mention the money he made from selling songs. But who would have known that an extra two hundred thousand yuan had mysteriously appeared in his bank card.

Li Luo leaned over with a suspicious look and saw that it was indeed over five hundred thousand. His face was filled with confusion.

"It should only be around three hundred thousand. Why is there more?"

"What three hundred thousand? The most you could have made is about a hundred thousand, right?" Lin Xiuhong frowned deeply. "Where did all this money come from? Don't tell me you've gotten yourself into some kind of trouble!"

"Um... calm down, calm down first. Let me make a call." Li Luo was also a bit unsure, but he had a faint guess. He took out his phone and called Yan Zhusheng.

"Hello?" Yan Zhusheng answered almost instantly, not making Li Luo wait for long. "Li Luo, what's up?"

"My parents are here with me."

Just in case, he made the declaration first to prevent Yan Zhusheng from saying anything strange. That was what Li Luo, who knew her well, thought. He then continued, "Is your mom home? There's something I want to ask her."

"My mom's not here. What did you want to ask?" Yan Zhusheng asked curiously.

"It's like this," Li Luo said simply. "Auntie Yuan bought two of my songs before, right? The total was 210,000, but now my bank card has a total of five hundred thousand, which is two hundred thousand more than before. I was wondering if Auntie Yuan's side arranged for it?"

"Oh, that." Yan Zhusheng nodded. "Weren't you at the interview with us last Saturday?"

"I originally wanted to talk to you about the other copyright matters for 'Year Rings' when I invited you over, but the interview took up all the time, so we didn't discuss it in detail."

"But my mom is going to the Qianjiang TV station for the New Year's Eve gala, and they specifically requested that she sing this song. So my mom had the finance department send you a payment first. I'm not sure how much it was, though. It should be around two hundred thousand, I guess."

"Oh, no wonder." Li Luo nodded in realization. "Then please thank Auntie Yuan for me. There's no rush for the copyright contract. We can sign it whenever we have time."

"Mhm," Yan Zhusheng replied, then asked, "Have you tried on the sweater?"

"Um... I have." Li Luo glanced at his parents, saw them listening intently, and silently wiped away a cold sweat. "I don't have anything else, so I'll hang up now."

"Huh?" Yan Zhusheng was taken aback for a moment, then immediately said, "Hello, Uncle and Auntie. If you're hanging up, then... goodbye, Uncle and Auntie."

Li Luo: "...There's no need to be so polite."

"She's greeting us, what's your hurry?" Lin Xiuhong snatched the phone from Li Luo and shot her son a look. Then she asked kindly—

"Zhusheng, right? Auntie saw the sweater you gave him. It's very nice. Auntie has also prepared a scarf for you. I'll have Li Luo bring it to you later. See if you like it."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded, sounding a little happy. "Thank you, Auntie. I'm sure I'll like it."

"Zhusheng," Lin Xiuhong said with a smile, but she still couldn't hold back her confusion and quickly asked in detail, "What were you and Li Luo just talking about, something about selling two songs, and what was that 'Year Rings' copyright fee? What does it all mean?"

"About that." Hearing her question, Yan Zhusheng began to explain everything from start to finish.

After a few minutes, Yan Zhusheng had recounted the entire story of how Li Luo had sold several songs, finally allowing Li Guohong and Lin Xiuhong to understand the whole sequence of events.

After another round of cordial greetings, they hung up the phone. Lin Xiuhong handed the phone back to her son, then exchanged a look with her husband, her expression complex.

They originally thought it was already absurd that this kid was making money from writing, having saved up over a hundred thousand in just a few months, and last month's royalties were even more outrageous at over forty thousand.

But...

How did they not know that their son also had this talent for writing songs?

And not just writing songs, but people were actually buying them?

Just three songs had earned him a total of over four hundred thousand!

"That's not right." Lin Xiuhong looked at Li Guohong with a puzzled expression. "Don't you usually read this kid's book? Zhusheng said Li Luo first wrote that song 'Year Rings' in his book. How come you didn't know?"

"Um..." Li Guohong's expression stiffened for a moment, then he gave a sheepish smile. "I just skimmed through that part of the plot. I thought 'Year Rings' was just some old song I hadn't heard of, so I didn't pay much attention."

"But didn't Zhusheng say the song is quite popular?" Lin Xiuhong asked doubtfully. "You listen to Yuan Wanqing's songs often. How could you not know about this?"

"I just listen to the songs. Who has time to pay attention to these things?" Li Guohong said, looking exasperated.

He was busy at the breakfast shop from dawn till dusk every day. Where would he find the time to follow online gossip?

But Li Luo couldn't help but ask, "Doesn't Qidian have a comment section? You would have known if you'd even taken a glance, right?"

"I don't use your so-called Qidian..." Li Guohong mumbled softly. "Reading your book costs a few yuan a month. How can a father pay to read his son's book?"

Hearing this, Li Luo's face darkened, and he couldn't help but ask, "So how do you usually read it?"

"Aren't there free versions online?" Li Guohong said in a low voice. "It's not easy for me to save up for cigarettes. You're earning so much from your royalties, you don't need my little contribution, do you?"

Seeing Old Li's stingy look, Li Luo felt a headache coming on.

"Look at you, being so cheap." Even Lin Xiuhong couldn't stand it. She patted his shoulder and waved her hand grandly. "From now on, when you read Li Luo's book, you can come to me for reimbursement."

Li Guohong: "...Then I should thank you, my dear wife?"

"In any case, your cigarette money won't be increased. Smoking is bad for your health," Lin Xiuhong said. "Or you can ask Li Luo if he supports you."

"Mom is right." Li Luo nodded vigorously.

"Alright, that's enough for today. I'm going to take a shower." Lin Xiuhong held her forehead and waved her hand. "You kid, you just had to drop such big news to scare me. I need to digest this first."

"Mom, I haven't told you yet," Li Luo added. "At the beginning of this month, because of the interview Auntie Yuan participated in, my book's website collaborated to promote my book."

"So this month, the royalties will probably be far more than forty thousand. It might be over a hundred thousand."

"And that's just from a single website. Once my book reaches a million words, it will be distributed to other websites as well. The royalties should be even higher then."

"When the royalties are paid next month, you two should also prepare yourselves."

As soon as these words were spoken, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong subconsciously held their breath, almost forgetting what it felt like to breathe for a moment.

They suddenly realized today.

Their own son seemed to be a bit heaven-defying.

In less than half a year, he had almost earned back the six to seven hundred thousand yuan deposit they had put down when they bought the house!

(End of this chapter)
